checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames are 640x640 square across 5 s; the clip was generated silent. Audio can't be heard, but none was requested.
Same head, ear pieces, can and pot, and same style in every frame.

must.item: Yellow body, single eye, purple boots consistent
must.why: All frames keep a yellow body, one big round eye and purple boots. The eye shifts shape slightly.

must.item: Can visibly tips and water flows onto seedlings
must.why: The can tips and water streams into the pot at 0.5 s, 2 s and 4.8 s. At 3.5 s the can is raised and the water stops, so the pour isn't continuous.
Flat cartoon look is kept with no 3D or photoreal shift.

faults.what: The robot's hand and the can handle shift a little between frames. The pour starts at the very beginning and stops mid-clip, so the tipping motion looks loopy.
Water is a small pale-blue blob with slight artefacts at 4.8 s.
The robot's eye gets slightly squashed in some frames.

summary: The clip keeps the same cartoon robot and style, with the can tipping and water falling on the seedlings; the pour is slightly intermittent and the small details wobble a little.
